name: smwmusic-f-zero-maximum-velocity-empyrean-colony
title: F-Zero: Maximum Velocity - Empyrean Colony
description:
This is a more enhanced arrangement of the Empyrean Colony theme from F-Zero: Maximum Velocity, where it's a bit fuller this time around thanks to Jay Reichard's MIDI, which was used here. Could fit final levels better, but it could also be useful for sky levels I guess.

EDIT: Fixed a few stuff, and added a actual description to the SPC (sorry for not putting it before lol)
